{{Top|leg}}
A '''fuel container''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ''[[Transtom]]'' was a fuel container, and was destroyed en route to the main fleet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
